literal: When the time comes that enmity becomes friendship, befriending with the face, avoiding friendship of the heart, one should abandon them.
translation: When a time comes where enemies pretend to be friends, one should reciprocate friendship only with a smiling face, while completely avoiding any true friendship of the heart.
modern: பகைவர் நண்பராக நடிக்கும் காலம் வரும்போது, முக அளவில் மட்டும் நட்பு காட்டி, மனப்பூர்வமான நட்பைத் தவிர்த்து அவர்களை விட்டுவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises how to deal with insincere or hostile alliances. When circumstances force an enemy to seek your friendship, you should not reject them openly; instead, show a friendly face (முகநட்டு) to maintain appearances. However, you must strictly avoid establishing any genuine, deep friendship of the heart (அகநட்பு ஒரீஇ) with them. Ultimately, you must keep them at a distance and let them go, as their inner hostility remains unchanged.
